1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 40 cm de longitud, cuerpo romboidal y comprimido, de color plateado, hocico prominente, boca pequeña, aletas pectorales transparentes y aletas pélvicas y anal amarillas. GerreidaeDiapterus rhombeus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 40 cm in length, with a rhomboid and compressed body, silvery color, prominent snout, small mouth, transparent pectoral fins, and yellowish pelvic and anal fins. Family Gerreidae, Diapterus rhombeus.
